Pull Apart Garlic Bread  Ingredients * 1 tsp yeast * 1 tbsp sugar * 270g milk (about 1 cup + 2 tbsp) * 380g flour (about 3 cups) * 1 tsp salt * 43g softened butter (about 3 tbsp) Butter Mixture * 100g butter, softened * 1 tbsp chopped cilantro * 1 garlic clove, minced * Shredded cheese Instructions 1. In a bowl, mix the sugar and yeast. Add the milk, then add the flour and mix until combined. 2. Add the salt and softened butter, then coil fold until the butter is fully incorporated. 3. Steak Cheese and Rice is easy to make and never disappoints! 🌮 INGREDIENTS  1 1/2 lbs Sirloin or New York Strip steak, sliced thin  1/2 tsp each salt and pepper 1 tsp each cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder 2 tsp chili powder 2 cups Jasmine rice rinsed  2 tbsp olive oil divided  1 small onion chopped 3 cups chicken broth 1 tbsp tomato Bouillon  1 1/2 cups White Queso 1 tbsp Fresh Cilantro 1 package Fajita size flour tortillas INSTRUCTIONS  Slice 1 1/2 lbs of steak into thin pieces. Add your sliced steak to a bowl with 1 tbsp olive oil. Season with salt, pepper, cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder, and chili powder. Stir until steak is well coated in seasoning and oil. Set aside.   Rinse 2 cups of Jasmine rice. Add rice to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 tbsp of olive oil and stir the rice around the skillet letting it toast up for 4-5 minutes.  Add the chopped onion and tomato bouillon to the skillet. Stir well. Add 3 cups of chicken broth. Stir well and let cook until it starts bubbling.  Once the whole skillet is bubbling, cover with a lid, lower the heat to medium low, and let cook for about 18 minutes or until rice is tender.   While the rice is cooking, heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the steak until it is cooked to your liking. I cooked the steak for about 10 minutes. Remove it from the heat.  Top the cooked rice with the steak and pour white queso over the skillet of steak and rice. Top with fresh cilantro. Serve as is or inside of flour tortillas.  #easyrecipes #dinner #steak

Strawberry Nutella Brownies 🍓🤎 Perfect brownies for summer!  (recipe makes an 8x8 pan) Ingredients:  10 tbsp (140g) unsalted butter, melted 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar ¼ cup (50g) brown sugar, packed  2 eggs, room temp 1 tsp vanilla extract ½ cup + 2 tbsp (56g) unsweetened cocoa powder ½ tsp salt 1 tbsp (13g) vegetable oil ½ cup (63g) all purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in) ¾ cup chocolate chips 190g (~⅔ cup) Nutella  Topping: Strawberry slices, patted dry (as many as you want/enough to cover the top) Nutella (to spread over the top & drizzle)  Instructions: Line an 8x8 pan with parchment paper. Spread the nutella onto the parchment into a thin, even square the size of the pan. Freeze for at least 30 minutes or until frozen solid. Preheat oven to 325°F and line/grease an 8x8 pan with parchment. In a large bowl, whisk melted butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla, then whisk vigorously for 1-2 minutes. Stir in cocoa powder and salt until fully combined. Mix in oil, then gently fold in the flour until just combined (don’t over mix). Fold in chocolate chips. Spread half the batter into the greased pan. Place the frozen nutella sheet on top of it. Then, spread the remaining batter over it to cover the nutella layer completely. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick near the center comes out with no wet batter. It should just come out with a little nutella & slightly moist crumbs. Let the brownies cool completely. Spread a thin layer of nutella over the cooled brownies, add strawberry slices (patted dry) all over the top, and drizzle with more nutella.  Best enjoyed fresh!  #bakingrecipe #brownies #chocolatestrawberries #nutella #recipe

Nashville Hot Chicken Caesar Sandwich 🌶️ Ingredients Chicken 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, pounded evenly Salt, to taste Oil, for deep-frying Nashville Hot Seasoning 1 tbsp cayenne pepper 2 tbsp brown sugar 1 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp black pepper 1 tbsp garlic powder 1 tbsp onion powder 2 tsp salt (Mix all seasoning ingredients together. Some will remain after preparing the chicken, flour, buttermilk, and hot oil.) Seasoned Flour 2 cups all-purpose flour 1/2 cup cornstarch 1 tsp baking powder 2 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Buttermilk Mixture 2 cups buttermilk 2 large eggs 1 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Nashville Hot Oil 1/2 cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Caesar Dressing 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp freshly grated Parmesan 1 tbsp lemon juice 1 tsp Dijon mustard 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce 1 small garlic clove, finely grated 1/2 tsp black pepper 1–2 tbsp cold water, as needed Salt, to taste Caesar Salad 1 cup finely chopped romaine 2–3 tbsp Caesar dressing 1–2 tbsp freshly grated Parmesan Assembly 5–6 toasted brioche or rustic buns Dill pickle slices Parmesan cheese Extra Caesar dressing, as needed Instructions Cut chicken into 5–6 sandwich-sized pieces, pound evenly, and season lightly with salt. Whisk all Caesar dressing ingredients until smooth. Add water as needed, adjust salt and lemon, and refrigerate. Mix flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and 2 tbsp seasoning. In another bowl, whisk buttermilk, eggs, and 1 tbsp seasoning. Coat chicken in flour, dip in buttermilk, then coat in flour again, pressing to create a craggy crust. Rest on a wire rack for 5–10 minutes. Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry in batches until golden and crispy and the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C). Drain on a wire rack. Carefully whisk 2 tbsp seasoning into 1/2 cup hot frying oil. Brush a thin layer over both sides of the chicken, adjusting to taste. Toss romaine with Caesar dressing and Parmesan just before assembling. Spread Caesar dressing on toasted buns. Add dressed lettuce, hot chicken, pickles, and Parmesan. Finish with extra dressing on the top bun, if desired. #nashville #hotchicken #sandwich #recipe

Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy. 5. Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY! Storage and Reheating Tips - Store chicken and creamy sauce in separate containers in the fridge. - When ready to eat, just warm up chicken in oven/air fryer for 4-5 mins 180C / 370F. Nashville Hot Chicken Mac & Cheese  Recipe ⬇️ Ridiculously creamy four-cheese mac and cheese with a crispy golden cheese crust, topped with crunchy fried chicken coated in a spicy Nashville hot oil! Mac & Cheese 16 oz cavatappi pasta 4 tbsp butter 4 tbsp flour 12 oz evaporated milk 1 cup heavy cream 1 cup whole milk 12 oz Colby Jack 8 oz sharp cheddar 8 oz mozzarella 4 oz Fontina 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp smoked paprika ½ tsp cayenne pepper 1 tsp Dijon mustard ½ tsp chicken bouillon Salt & black pepper Reserved pasta water Fried Chicken 2 lb chicken tenderloins 2 cups buttermilk 2 tbsp hot sauce 2 cups flour ½ cup cornstarch 1 tbsp paprika 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder & cayenne Salt & black pepper Oil for frying Nashville Hot Oil ½ cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp cayenne pepper 1 tbsp brown sugar 2 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp chili powder ½ tsp black pepper ½ tsp salt Directions Cook pasta 1–2 minutes shy of al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water. Melt butter, whisk in flour and cook 1–2 minutes. Slowly add evaporated milk, cream, milk and seasonings. Simmer until slightly thickened. Reduce heat to low and melt in 16 oz of the shredded cheese. Reserve the other 16 oz for layering. Fold in pasta, adding reserved pasta water as needed to keep it extra creamy. Layer half the mac in a baking dish, add 6 oz reserved cheese, then remaining mac and 10 oz cheese on top. Bake uncovered at 350°F for 20–25 minutes, then broil 1–3 minutes until golden and crispy. Marinate chicken in buttermilk and hot sauce for at least 30 minutes. Mix flour, cornstarch and seasonings, then coat chicken thoroughly. Fry chicken at 350°F for 4–6 minutes until crispy and 165°F internally. Combine Nashville hot oil spices in a heatproof bowl. Carefully pour ½ cup hot frying oil over the spices and stir until combined. Brush or toss the fried chicken in Nashville hot oil, then pile it over the baked mac and cheese. Enjoy! 🔥 #nashvillehotchicken #macandcheese #friedchicken #comfortfood #recipe

Arsenio’s Chipotle Mac n Cheese Balls 🧀 Recipe👇🏽 Ingredients ½ lb (227 g) cavatappi pasta ¼ cup (57 g) butter ⅓ cup (40–45 g) all-purpose flour 1½ cups (360 ml) milk 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp black pepper ¼ chicken bouillon cube, grated 1 tbsp chipotle pepper sauce 1 cup (100 g) shredded marble cheese 1 cup (100 g) shredded mozzarella 1 cup (100 g) extra shredded mozzarella for binding Salt to taste, if needed 2 eggs, beaten Panko breadcrumbs Oil for frying Instructions Cook the cavatappi in salted water until al dente, then drain well. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic powder, paprika and black pepper, then stir in the flour. Cook for 1–2 minutes, stirring constantly. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Keep stirring until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Add the grated chicken bouillon and chipotle pepper sauce. Turn off the heat, add the marble cheese and mozzarella, and stir until melted. Taste and add salt if needed. Mix the cooked pasta into the cheese sauce until everything is coated. Add the extra 1 cup of shredded mozzarella and mix until combined. Scoop portions onto pieces of parchment paper. Wrap the parchment around each portion and twist the ends to form tight balls. Place on a tray and freeze for about 1 hour, or until firm. Dip each ball into the beaten eggs, then coat generously in panko breadcrumbs. Heat the oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry until golden and crispy, making sure the centres are heated through. Larger balls may need extra time, so test one first. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. Let them cool slightly, break one open and enjoy that cheesy centre. I hope it crunches! ❤️

Enjoy!     Steak bites (makes 2 servings) * 2 boneless ribeyes, about 1–1½ pounds (450–680 g) total * 1 tablespoon avocado oil, 15 ml, plus more if needed * ½ teaspoon fine salt, 3 g, or to taste * ½ teaspoon freshly cracked black pepper * 1 tsp paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder  Garlic honey butter * 4-5 tbsps unsalted butter * 5 garlic cloves, 15 g, minced or finely chopped  * 3-4 tbsps honey, more or less to taste  * 1-2 teaspoons soy sauce sauce * 1 tbsp fresh thyme chopped * 1/2 tsp red pepper chili flakes (optional) * 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley, 4 g * Freshly cracked black pepper * Salt, to taste Tender heirloom carrots * 6-8 heirloom carrots, peeled, washed, stems cut * 1 tablespoon avocado oil, 15 ml * Splash of water  * ¼ teaspoon fine salt * Black pepper, to taste Creamy mash  * 6-7 gold potatoes, peeled, rinsed, boiled  * 3-4 tbsps unsalted butter * 1/4 cup heavy cream, more or less for desired consistency  * Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions pinned in the comments  #steak #foodie #explore #recipe  1. Pan sear carrots on medium heat until fork tender. Set aside.  2. Peel, rinse, cut potatoes into large chunks and boil them in salted water until fork tender. Drain and steam dry for 10 minutes.  3. Mash potatoes with a ricer or mixer (on low speed) until smooth.  4. Heat the mash on low heat in a pot adding the heavy cream, butter, salt and pepper to taste. Set aside and keep warm.  5. Trim away any large, hard pieces of exterior fat, pat steaks dry. Cut into 1 inch bite sized pieces, season.  6. Sear the steak bites in batches in a cast iron or skillet over medium high heat for 1 minute flipping each piece over halfway through. Do not overcrowd the pan for even searing. Remove the steak bites and set aside. 7. In the same pan clean off any black residue from the steak, keeping the browned pan drippings. Add the butter and garlic, stirring it around for 1 min on medium heat. Add the honey, followed by the rest of the garlic honey butter ingredients until glossy.  8. Return steak bites back to the pan and continue to cook in the garlic honey butter for another minute or two or until it’s cooked to your liking.

🔥 Homemade Chicken Arayes in Pitta Bread 🫓  Crispy, golden pitta breads stuffed with juicy, flavour-packed chicken mince, fresh herbs, garlic and a delicious blend of spices… finished in the oven and served with my homemade garlic & herb sauce! 🤤 Honestly, the perfect combination! These homemade chicken Arayes are so easy to make, packed with flavour and perfect for a quick lunch, easy dinner or sharing platter. Think crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside and full of those fresh, herby flavours! 😍 ✨ Ingredients 🛒 * Chicken mince * ½ white onion, finely chopped * Spring onions, chopped * Fresh parsley & dill * Fresh garlic * Salt & black pepper * Paprika * A drizzle of oil * Chilli flakes (optional 🌶️) * Pitta breads 👩‍🍳 Method 1. Add the chicken mince to a bowl with the finely chopped onion, spring onion, parsley, dill, fresh garlic, salt, pepper, paprika, a drizzle of oil and optional chilli flakes. Mix everything together until well combined. 2. Cut the pitta breads in half and carefully stuff each pocket with the chicken mixture, spreading the filling evenly. 3. Heat a little oil in a skillet and place the stuffed pitta breads face down. Cook for a few minutes until the bread starts to turn golden and crispy. 4. Mix some oil with dried mixed herbs, salt and black pepper, then brush over the outside of the pitta breads while they’re still in the pan. 5. Transfer the oven-safe skillet to a preheated oven at 180°C for around 10–15 minutes, keeping the pitta breads face down. Cook until the chicken reaches 75°C in the centre and is fully cooked through. If your pan isn’t oven-safe, transfer them to a baking tray. 6. Remove from the oven, let them rest briefly and serve hot with your homemade garlic & herb sauce for the ultimate flavour combination! 🧄🌿 🌶️ The best part? You can make these any way you like to suit your own taste buds! Add extra chilli for a spicy kick, switch up the herbs, experiment with your favourite spices or try different dipping sauces. Make them your own and get creative with the flavours! Simple ingredients, big flavours and the perfect homemade fakeaway! 🤌✨ #arayes #recipes #quickrecipes #dinnerideas #dinner

Thai Peanut Chicken & Noodles 🥜🍜 Crockpot Series Episode 16: Thai Peanut Chicken & Noodles This is my crockpot series, where I help you make easy recipes so good you might find a spouse or impress the one you’ve got. This Thai-inspired dish was so good: tender chicken, creamy peanut sauce and noodles coated in all that flavor! Ingredients: 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs 2 tablespoons of Butter, for searing 1 can (13.5 oz) full-fat unsweetened coconut milk ¼ cup low-sodium shoyu (soy sauce) 2 Tbsp brown sugar 2 Tbsp minced garlic 1 Tbsp grated ginger 2 Tbsp Thai red curry paste, or less for milder heat ¾ cup creamy peanut butter 2 Tbsp fresh lime juice 14 oz dry flat rice noodles 1 red bell pepper, thinly sliced 1 cup shredded carrots 1 large sliced onion to put at bottom of crockpot  Toppings: Chopped peanuts Sliced green onions Chopped cilantro Optional slurry: 1 Tbsp cornstarch + 1 Tbsp cold water Instructions: 1. Give the chicken thighs a hard sear in butter until nicely browned on both sides. Transfer to the crockpot. 2. Mix coconut milk, shoyu, brown sugar, garlic, ginger and curry paste. Pour over chicken. Cover and cook on LOW 4–5 hours or HIGH 2–3 hours, until tender and at least 165°F internally. 3. Remove chicken and keep covered. Add bell pepper and carrots to the sauce. Cook on HIGH 20–30 minutes, until just tender. 4. Whisk peanut butter with about 2 cup of hot crockpot liquid until smooth, then stir it back into the sauce. 5. If the sauce needs thickening, stir in the cornstarch slurry. Cook on HIGH until gently bubbling and thickened. For a quicker finish, transfer sauce to a saucepan and gently simmer, stirring, for 1–2 minutes after adding the slurry. 6. Prepare noodles separately according to the package and drain. Cut chicken into chunks and return to the sauce. Stir in lime juice and gently toss in noodles. Add a splash of hot water only if needed to loosen. 7. Top with peanuts, green onions and cilantro. Serve immediately—the noodles soak up the sauce as they sit! Note: if sauce is to thick, add warm water or low-sodium chicken broth, 1–2 tablespoons at a time, gently stirring until the sauce loosens and coats the noodles. Fried half, froze the rest, and delivered FIVE with sauce to my neighbor’s door on a platter. Somebody notify the HOA—I deserve an award. 😂 INGREDIENTS • 2 (8-ounce) blocks cream cheese, softened • 20 ounces imitation crab, finely chopped • 2 cups shredded mozzarella • 1 bunch green onions, sliced, including light green and a little white • 1 tablespoon powdered sugar • 2 teaspoons garlic powder • ½ teaspoon salt BREADING • 1 cup flour • 3 eggs, beaten • 3 cups crushed Doritos Spicy Sweet Chili chips • 1 cup plain panko • Frying oil • Sweet chili sauce for dipping Breading amounts are starting quantities; add more as needed. HOW TO 1. Mix filling ingredients. Press into an even layer on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Freeze about 1 hour, until firm enough to cut. 2. Cut into roughly 2-by-2-inch squares. 3. Coat in flour, then egg, then combined Doritos and panko, pressing crumbs onto all sides. 4. Fry in hot oil in batches until golden and hot inside—mine took about 1½ minutes per side. 5. Drain on a wire rack and serve with sweet chili sauce. FREEZER STASH: Freeze extra breaded squares until firm, then bag with parchment between layers. #recipe #crabrangoon #dinner #food #easyrecipe

Creamy Lemon Italian Sausage & Spinach Pasta 🍋🤎 INGREDIENTS: • 12 oz Brami protein fusilli pasta • 1 lb Italian sausage • ½ onion, diced • 4 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp butter • 3½ cups chicken broth • ¾ cup heavy cream • 1 cup Parmesan cheese • 1 cup frozen spinach • 2 tsp Italian seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • ½ tsp red pepper flakes • 1 lemon (zest & juice) HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. In a pot, brown Italian sausage over medium-high heat, breaking it into crumbles. Remove and set aside. 2. Add butter and diced onion to the same pot. Sauté until softened, then add garlic and cook for 30 seconds. 3. Add Italian seasoning, black pepper, and red pepper flakes. Stir to combine. 4. Pour in a splash of chicken broth and scrape up all the flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pot. 5. Add the remaining chicken broth and uncooked pasta. Stir well and bring to a gentle boil. 6. Cook according to the pasta package directions (mine took about 10 minutes), stirring occasionally so the pasta doesn’t stick. Allow most of the broth to cook down, leaving a little liquid in the pot. 7. Once the pasta is tender, reduce the heat. Stir in heavy cream, spinach, Parmesan cheese, and lemon zest. 8. Add the cooked Italian sausage back into the pot. Stir everything together and let sit for a few minutes until the spinach is heated through. 9. Finish with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice to brighten up the sauce! 🍋 LEMON TIP: If you don’t have a zester like me, you can use a vegetable peeler to remove the yellow outer peel of the lemon.  Finely dice the peel with a knife, and use it just like lemon zest! #CreamyPasta #ItalianSausagePasta #OnePotDinner #EasyDinnerIdeas #CookingWithMrsRachel
